english.note: Use this when someone no longer does an activity, especially in everyday speech.
Use this as the all-purpose spoken way to say that someone will no longer do an activity.

examples.english: They cease smoking after the doctor warns them.
examples.traditional: 醫生警告過佢哋之後，佢哋就唔再食煙喇。
